title: User Registration with Valid Data
description: Verify that a user can successfully register with valid inputs and completes profile setup without errors.

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page
Fill in valid registration details (email, username, password)
Submit the registration form
Confirm registration success message is displayed and user is directed to profile setup
Complete profile setup with valid data and submit
Profile is saved successfully and user is navigated to the dashboard

title: User Login with Correct Credentials
description: Check if a user can login successfully using correct email and password.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Enter valid email and password
Click login button
Login succeeds and dashboard page is displayed

title: Password Reset Flow
description: Verify that users can request password reset email and successfully reset password using the link.

steps.description: Navigate to forgot password page
Enter registered email and submit password reset request
Confirm that password reset email is sent
Use password reset link to navigate to reset password page
Enter new password and confirm password
Submit new password
Password is updated and user can login with new password

title: Create New Project with AI-Generated Task Suggestions
description: Validate that a user can create a new project using the multi-step wizard and receive AI-suggested tasks and milestones which can be confirmed or edited.

steps.description: Navigate to create new project page
Complete project creation steps including name, description, and settings
AI-generated timeline and task suggestions are displayed
Modify or accept AI-generated tasks and milestones
Submit and complete project creation
Project is created successfully and appears in the project list

title: Edit and Delete Project
description: Ensure that users can edit project details and delete projects correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to existing project page
Edit project details such as name and description
Save changes
Project details are updated and reflected in the project view
Delete the project via project settings
Project is removed from the project list

title: Create, Read, Update and Delete Task with Nested Subtasks
description: Confirm that tasks support full CRUD operations including adding nested subtasks, updating statuses/priorities, and deletion.

steps.description: Navigate to a project's task management view
Create a new task with title, description, priority, and status
Newly created task appears correctly in task list
Add nested subtasks to the created task
Subtasks are displayed as nested under the parent task
Update task and subtask statuses and priorities
Status and priority updates are saved and visible
Delete the task
Task and all subtasks are removed from the list

title: AI Document Analysis and Task Generation Accuracy
description: Test the AI-powered document analysis to extract academic requirements and auto-generate tasks, verifying accuracy and user acceptance.

steps.description: Navigate to document analyzer page
Upload or input academic document text for analysis
AI extracts key requirements and displays generated tasks
Review and edit generated tasks
Accept tasks for addition to project
Tasks are added correctly and at least 40% user acceptance is met

title: View and Manage Tasks in Calendar with Color Coding
description: Validate that calendar view displays all project deadlines with appropriate color coding and supports task addition and rescheduling.

steps.description: Navigate to calendar view
Calendar shows tasks/deadlines across multiple projects with correct color coding
Add a new task directly from calendar quick add
New task appears at selected date with proper color coding
Reschedule an existing task by dragging or editing date
Task date updates properly and calendar reflects the change

title: Resource Management: Link Resources to Tasks and Search
description: Ensure users can add, tag, organize, and search links and file resources linked to tasks.

steps.description: Navigate to resource management page within a project
Add a new link or file resource with tags
New resource is listed with correct tags
Link resource to a specific task
Resource appears as linked within task details
Perform search for resources using tag or keyword
Search results correctly reflect related resources

title: Real-Time Messaging and Notifications Functionality
description: Verify real-time project messaging functionality along with notification delivery and user settings management.

steps.description: Open project messaging page and send a message
Message appears instantly to other online team members
Trigger notification for a new message
User receives a notification alert
Navigate to notification settings page
Change notification preferences and save
Notification settings are updated and respected for future alerts

title: Data Insights Dashboard Accuracy and Performance
description: Confirm that data insights and analytics dashboards update correctly reflecting project metrics and productivity data with dashboard load time under 2 seconds.

steps.description: Navigate to data insights dashboard
Dashboard loads within 2 seconds
Charts and metrics display accurate data corresponding to project progress and productivity
Trigger updates by modifying project or task data
Dashboard reflects new data correctly in real-time or on refresh

title: Project Archiving and Restoration
description: Validate that users can archive projects to remove them from active views and restore archived projects when needed.

steps.description: Select a project and archive it via project settings
Project is no longer visible in active projects list but appears in archived list
Restore archived project
Project reappears in active projects list and is functional

title: Task Dependencies Management
description: Verify task dependency creation, enforcement, and impact on task status updates.

steps.description: Create two tasks, set one as dependent on the other
Dependency relationship is saved and visible
Attempt to mark dependent task as complete before the parent task completes
System prevents status update due to dependency constraint
Complete the parent task
Dependent task can now be completed

title: User Profile Editing and Validation
description: Check that users can edit their profile information with validation on inputs and successful updates.

steps.description: Navigate to profile edit page
Modify profile fields with valid and invalid inputs
Validation errors are shown for invalid inputs
Save valid profile changes
Profile information is updated successfully

title: API Performance Under Load
description: Test that all API calls for critical features respond within 500ms under expected load.

steps.description: Simulate multiple concurrent users performing project/task CRUD and AI operations
All API calls return within 500ms

title: System Uptime Verification
description: Verify that system uptime meets or exceeds 99.5% during extended monitoring periods.

steps.description: Monitor system availability and responsiveness over 30 days
System uptime is >= 99.5% without significant downtime

title: Handling of Incomplete or Invalid Project Creation Inputs
description: Ensure proper validation messages are shown and project creation is blocked for invalid or missing inputs.

steps.description: Navigate to create new project page
Attempt to proceed with missing mandatory fields such as project name
Validation errors prevent progressing to next step
Enter invalid values for fields like dates or task durations
Form shows appropriate error messages

title: Task Status Transition Validations
description: Check that task status transitions follow allowed workflows and prevent invalid status changes.

steps.description: Attempt to set a task status directly from 'To Do' to 'Done' without passing through 'In Progress'
System blocks invalid status transition with error message
Perform valid status transitions (To Do -> In Progress -> Done)
Status updates are successful and reflected in UI
